## Items needing a fix

### [22] INACCURATE - NemoClaw "only Podman mention" and "Podman not stated"
Claim (analysis.md "Laptop isolation path"; isolation-laptop.md "NemoClaw constraints"): "Its only Podman mention is the Ollama-based 'Hermes Portable' [22]"; "Whether NemoClaw-for-Hermes runs on a Podman-driver OpenShell gateway is not stated"; and the Recommendation section calls NemoClaw "Docker-driver based [23]".
Source [22] (Hermes quickstart): "Docker is the default runtime provider and primary path. On a qualified Linux host, you can instead select native rootless Podman explicitly with NEMOCLAW_GATEWAY_RUNTIME=podman ; this path does not require the Docker CLI or daemon." Source [23]: "Stock onboarding through the default Docker provider or the explicitly selected native Podman provider for OpenClaw, Hermes, and LangChain Deep Agents Code..." and "Native Podman is selected with NEMOCLAW_GATEWAY_RUNTIME=podman".
Fix: delete "Its only Podman mention is the Ollama-based Hermes Portable [22]". Replace with: Docker is the default runtime; native rootless Podman can be selected with `NEMOCLAW_GATEWAY_RUNTIME=podman`, with requirements and limitations on the Platform Support page (not fetched) [22][23]. Remove "Whether ... Podman-driver gateway is not stated" from isolation-laptop.md Details and Gaps. Reword "Docker-driver based [23]" (Recommendation, "Not recommended") and "uses Docker-driver containers [23]" to "Docker by default; native Podman optional". The "poor fit" conclusion needs re-basing on alpha status [24], the exact 0.0.116 pin [23] and default telemetry [22], not on Docker dependence.

### [44] NOT FOUND - "Loopback when run locally"
Claim (analysis.md interfaces table, OpenHands Agent Canvas row; interaction-interfaces.md row 4; citations.md row 44 "local listeners bind 127.0.0.1"): Agent Canvas binds loopback when run locally [44].
Source [44] has no "127.0.0.1", "loopback" or "localhost" bind statement. It gives the install-mode table (npm: "Runs directly on your machine"; Docker: "only sees the directories you mount"). Source [56] says the opposite for the Agent Canvas desktop client: "both services hosting it bind to all network interfaces ( :: , functionally equivalent to 0.0.0.0 )".
Fix: remove "Loopback when run locally [44]" from analysis.md and interaction-interfaces.md row 4, and the bind claim from citations.md row 44. Replace with "Default bind not stated in [44]; issue [56] reports an all-interfaces bind". Also analysis.md Not-recommended: "local runtime expects Docker per conversation [44]" rests only on a nav-menu title ("Run Each Conversation in Its Own Docker Container"). Cite the page itself or soften to "offers a Docker-per-conversation mode".

### [122] PARTIAL - "before any model call or approval" applies to Goose, not Hermes
Claim (analysis.md Security record; isolation-k3s-security.md pattern note): "Hermes [122] and Goose [89] both ran a cloned repository's .git/config core.fsmonitor command before any model call or approval."
Source [122]: "When a user opens the malicious repository and sends any message, the agent triggers a git status index refresh which executes the injected command in the user's process context, exposing the full environment including configured provider API keys." No statement about before approval or before a model call. Source [89] does say it for Goose: "runs before goose contacts a model and without a submitted prompt, model call, tool approval, or trust prompt."
Fix: write "Hermes ran it on the first message sent in the repository [122]; Goose ran it before any model call or approval [89]." Keep "only an outer sandbox contains this class" as labelled inference.

### [132] PARTIAL - "escape" and "DNS tunnelling"

Fix: "the vector an OpenAI research model used to reach an external chatbot from a training sandbox [131][132]".
